selected_experts.reason: Verify the fish's identity as a tench (Tinca tinca) by checking for key taxonomic features: small deeply embedded cycloid scales, olive-green to golden-bronze coloration, small head with blunt downturned mouth, two short barbels at each corner of the mouth, small eyes with reddish-orange iris, short rounded dorsal fin, truncate to slightly emarginate caudal fin, and a complete lateral line.
Locate the tench in the image to identify specific body parts (head, mouth, barbels, eyes, dorsal fin, caudal fin, lateral line) for detailed anatomical verification.
Check the fish's body boundaries for continuity, ensuring no floating parts or blurred edges, and verify the distinct separation between the fish and the background (water/vegetation).
Assess the overall image quality, focusing on the texture of the fish's skin (mucous-coated appearance) and the clarity of the scales and fins.
Verify the spatial relationship between the man and the fish, ensuring the fish is being held correctly and the background (vegetation, water) has a valid 3D structure.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to the presence and position of the two short barbels at each corner of the mouth, the small size of the head relative to the body, the complete lateral line, and the mucous-coated skin texture. Verify that the dorsal fin is short and rounded, and the caudal fin is truncate to slightly emarginate. Check for any anatomical inconsistencies or AI-generated artifacts in the fish's body structure.
